Units

Source: R/changing.R
units.Rd

Unit helpers from manim.utils.unit: Pixels converts pixels to scene units at the current resolution, Percent(X_AXIS) converts a percentage of the frame width (or height for Y_AXIS), Degrees converts degrees to radians and Munits is one scene unit. Multiply a number by a unit: 50 * Pixels, 25 * Percent(X_AXIS).

Usage

Pixels

Percent(axis)

Degrees

Munits

Arguments

axis

X_AXIS or Y_AXIS.

Examples

100 * Pixels
#> [1] 0.7407407
10 * Percent(X_AXIS)
#> [1] 1.422222
